# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please report security vulnerabilities privately, not through public issues.

**Preferred:** use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting — the **"Report a
vulnerability"** button on this repository's **Security** tab. It opens a private
advisory visible only to the maintainers.

Alternatively, email **security@brimham.app**.

We aim to acknowledge your report within 3 working days and will keep you updated
as we investigate and prepare a fix. Once a fix is released we will credit you,
unless you prefer to remain anonymous.

## Supported Versions

Security fixes are applied to the latest released version.
